# @uptimizr/babylon-lite

> The Babylon Lite (`@babylonjs/lite`) connector for Uptimizr — a functional, WebGPU-only Babylon
> engine, so the adapter mirrors the three.js shape (app owns the canvas; picking is explicit and
> async). `@babylonjs/lite` is an optional peer dependency. Lite's native frame is already the
> canonical wire frame.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): quick start, the capture table, coordinate frame, graphics, limitations.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Connector guide](https://uptimizr.com/docs/connectors/babylon-lite/): the docs-site walkthrough.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track and query the data.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003), input-source-agnostic events (0011), sampling & fidelity (0012), coordinate frame & connector provenance (0018), Babylon Lite connector (0024), scene actors (0027), world-space gaze (0030).

## Key exports

- `trackScene(scene, camera, canvas, options)` — one-call integration; returns the `UptimizrClient`.
- `trackSceneAsync(scene, camera, canvas, options)` — same, resolving the real WebGPU backend first.
- `liteCollector(options)` — the collector for manual composition (`client.use(...)`).
- `readDeviceCaps()`, `readGraphics()` / `readGraphicsAsync()`, `readConnector(overrides)`,
  `readSceneMeta(scene, camera)`, `classifyCamera(camera)` — the `session_start` provenance blocks.
- `scanSceneProxy(scene, options)` — per-mesh world-AABB scene proxy (spatial heatmap backdrop).
- `createScenePicker(scene)` — the async GPU pick probe (`LitePickProbe`, with its own `dispose()`).
- `toVec3`, `clamp01` — vector helpers.
